scope: Manual topup lifecycle and wallet operating limits audit; independent driver cash payout audit is next
findings: Manual topup audit captures actor ID/amount but not immutable staff identity or balance before/after
Reject path lacks live staff profile/version guard inside transaction
Date-partition audit sort key uses timestamp alone, permitting overwrite on same-millisecond requests
Pending operating limit proposal audit needs to retain proposed numbers independently of mutable pending slot
changes: financialAudit projections retain staff profile name/roles/version/scope read at action, with ID_ONLY for nonstaff/unavailable historical identity
Approval audit stores pending->approved state, exact available/locked/version snapshots and transaction/ledger references; no balance calculation changed
Create/reject explicitly record no monetary effect rather than invent wallet balances not read
Each topup audit uses timestamp+topup+action(+transaction) and conditional immutable Put in original atomic transaction
Reject validates reason and rechecks live finance.topup.review with staff active/version fence inside transaction; conflict returns actionable 409
Operating limit proposal audit includes proposedConfig and activeConfigChanged=false; saved active changes explicitly marked
Audit free text redacts bearer/JWT/signed-link material; oversized free text is explicitly hash/length marked

specificCases: Exact audit balance delta and unchanged locked balance
Trusted staff profile roles retained instead of caller-provided role label
Rejected topup has reason/state and no balance update
Revoked staff version at commit prevents status/notification/audit writes
Two approvals at same timestamp have different immutable audit keys
Limit proposal archived while active config remains unchanged
Existing identity, transfer, payout and funding retry tests stay green

No historical audit row rewrites or invented names
No actual topup approval/rejection or balance mutation performed for deployment

remaining: Driver cash payout actor and before/after audit projections
